public_definitions: The goal is to review the cereal comparison dashboard and assign the 11-18 years category to the most appropriate adolescent fibre-support follow-up route.
The comparison scope is the displayed comparison for the 11-18 years age group.
The rules are to determine which cereal category should be escalated for adolescent fibre-support follow-up, or whether it should be sent for general reference review.
